description:
Self-signed delegation manifest published into a channel's main envelope stream. A principal emits an `agentManifest` to announce — over the wire — the current shape of their *agent delegation tree*: which agents (scribes today; future roles additively) they have authorized to sign envelopes on their behalf, with what role and substrate, as of when.

**Distinct from `tech.equanimi.secretariat.rosterUpdate`.** rosterUpdate is *admin-signed* and answers 'who is a member of this channel?' (the admin attests). agentManifest is *self-signed* and answers 'which keys have I authorized to act on my behalf?' (the principal attests). The two records cannot be merged: the admin doesn't know the member's agent keys, and the member can't unilaterally write themselves onto a roster. They are complementary: rosterUpdate gates wire access; agentManifest binds delegated signers to the principal who delegated.

The receiver runs the substrate-for-themia verifier chain (element §1, P2 hop 3): envelope signature verifies → resolve author DID → consult cached agentManifest snapshots indexed by candidate principals (channel owner + roster members) → return `{author_role: agent | principal, agent_role: scribe | …, substrate: …, principal_did: …}`.

This record is the on-wire dual of the principal-private `authorized_agents` field in `tech.equanimi.secretariat.identity`. The identity record stays on-device (per its lexicon `description`); agentManifest is the public-facing artifact derived from it. Emitted on:
  • invite acceptance (`sec invite accept` → agentManifest envelope into every channel the new member joins)
  • `sec agent add` / `sec agent rotate` / `sec agent remove` (refresh agentManifest into every channel the principal is already a member of)

Latest-wins per `(signer, target)` pair. The receiver derives the current authorized-agents set by replaying agentManifest envelopes filtered by `$type` from the channel's main stream and keeping the most recent per signer.

Like `tech.equanimi.secretariat.stamp` and `tech.equanimi.secretariat.rosterUpdate`, this record carries its own ed25519 signature so a verifier can authenticate the manifest independent of envelope-level transport metadata. The signing key is the principal's active key (the same key that signs their `identity.md`).

signer.description: DID of the member principal authoring this declaration. Must match the verifying key the `signature` field checks against. This is the same DID the principal's `identity.md` carries.

target.description:
Scope the declaration applies to. Three forms:
  • `org:<org-did>` — declaration scoped to all channels in this org (broadcast to every channel the member belongs to in the org).
  • `channel:<owner-did>#<handle>` — declaration scoped to one specific channel.
  • `*` — global declaration (rare; for principals broadcasting to all peers they correspond with).
Receivers index cached snapshots by `(signer, target)`; a more-specific target overrides a broader one when both apply.

authorized_agents.description: Snapshot of the signer's currently-authorized agents at `declared_at`. Mirror of the principal-private `authorized_agents` array in `tech.equanimi.secretariat.identity`, exported for on-wire publication. Entry shape is identical: `{did, role, name, substrate, added_at}`. Empty array is meaningful — it means the principal has explicitly revoked all delegations.

did.description: The agent's DID. Receivers resolve envelope-author DIDs against this list to verify the agent is authorized by the claimed principal.

role.description: Agent role. Today only `scribe`. Future roles reuse the field additively.

name.description: Principal-chosen nickname. Free-form, used for human-readable presentation on the receiver side.

substrate.description: Cognition provider this agent runs under. Today `claude-code`; future values added additively.

added_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this agent was granted authority by the signer.

declared_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this declaration was authored. Receivers use this to break ties when multiple declarations from the same `(signer, target)` arrive; latest-wins by `declared_at`, then by record TID.

signature.description: Detached ed25519 signature over the canonical preimage of this record (sans the signature field itself). Format: `ed25519:<base64>` with 64 raw bytes. Canonical preimage: `agentManifest:v0:` byte prefix + UTF-8 serialization of a sorted-key JSON object containing every other field listed in this lexicon. Signed by the principal's active key (the same key referenced in their `identity.md::key_path`).
